sections.purpose: Provide the primary site navigation.
Explain the hosted MCP offer, free evaluation, and primary setup path in the first viewport.
Show the prerequisites, account flow, scoped-key boundary, generated client configuration, supported formats, and first verification task needed to connect an MCP.
Show a concrete RepoIntel request and the evidence-bearing response shape a connected client receives.
Help visitors identify available MCPs by workflow and continue into the full catalog.
Close the page with navigation, trust, and contact context.
Provide the primary site navigation.
Introduce the approved first-party MCP catalog and help visitors begin evaluating products by the problems they need to solve.
Answer which Monarchic products address each visitor’s problem or workflow without requiring prior knowledge of product names.
Give visitors enough comparable information to identify relevant products and open the appropriate detail page.
Explain how Monarchic’s MCP products can work together while keeping each product independently understandable and evaluable.
Define product maturity and show how applicable evidence is classified so visitors can judge readiness and claims correctly.
Route visitors to the appropriate product detail, separate application, external signup, or product-specific waitlist without handling product accounts or purchases here.
Close the page with navigation, trust, and contact context.
Provide the primary site navigation.
Identify the product, state its concise value proposition and lifecycle, and establish the relevant audience without implying unsupported availability.
Answer what problem the product solves, why existing approaches fall short, and which visitors and use cases it fits.
Show the supported outcomes, capabilities, and representative workflow at the product’s actual hosted scope.
Explain relevant architecture, system design, heuristics, integrations, and relationships to other Monarchic products.
State lifecycle, availability, limitations, readiness boundaries, and any verified pricing or demonstration without inventing unavailable details.
Present correctly scoped product evidence and limitations only when genuine evidence exists; omit the entire module otherwise.
Present only the configured next actions appropriate to the product’s lifecycle and available supporting material.
Close the page with navigation, trust, and contact context.
Provide the primary site navigation.
Establish the page as Monarchic’s authoritative library of approved research, evaluations, benchmarks, and engineering evidence.
Help visitors distinguish the three evidence classes and understand what each can and cannot support.
Present a limited set of approved representative findings with enough scope and limitation context to avoid decontextualized headline metrics.
Provide the complete browsable evidence index and connect every entry to its report and related product.
Explain Monarchic’s publication standards, comparability rules, reproducibility expectations, and non-uniform research coverage.
Let visitors continue to a complete evidence report or inspect the product associated with a result.
Close the page with navigation, trust, and contact context.
Provide the primary site navigation.
Identify the report, summarize its scope, state publication status and date, associate it with a product, and establish the report-level evidence classification.
Define the evaluated research questions or engineering claims and identify the type and provenance of every included result.
Render one repeatable, independently scoped study block for each included evaluation so protocols and metrics are never collapsed into one aggregate claim.
Synthesize what the results support and do not support while preserving failures, limitations, metric distinctions, and comparability constraints.
Provide the approved evidence paths, artifacts, configuration details, and instructions needed to inspect or reproduce the work.
Explain which MCP and exact product capability the report evaluates without generalizing beyond the tested scope.
Let readers inspect supporting artifacts, evaluate the related product, or return to the complete Research index.
Close the page with navigation, trust, and contact context.
Provide the primary site navigation.
Identify Monarchic, distinguish the public brand from its legal operator, and state the company’s automation mission.
Explain the enduring automation scope, present AI and MCP focus, broader audiences, and long-term fields without implying future availability.
Present Our approach as an evidence-first system of research, deterministic engineering, architecture, heuristics, reproducibility, and disciplined product development.
Show how research, underlying tooling, and commercial MCP products reinforce one another as a connected program rather than isolated releases.
Ground the operating method in correctly classified evidence and direct visitors toward published research and engineering verification.
Separate current products from long-term direction and describe Monarchic’s small, technically ambitious, long-horizon operating posture without implying unsupported scale.
Direct visitors toward current products, published research, or security and engineering practices based on their evaluation needs.
Close the page with navigation, trust, and contact context.
Provide the primary site navigation.
Define the Security page’s covered systems, exclusions, assurance scope, and last-updated context without making absolute claims.
Explain current hosted-runtime, security, data-handling, isolation, persistence, and product-specific boundaries.
Organize only confirmed engineering controls and identify where their applicability varies by product or lifecycle.
Show how artifacts and deployments are validated while distinguishing deployment, operational verification, lifecycle status, and complete readiness.
Present applicable operational evidence with its scope, date, provenance, and limitations without treating it as independent research.
Provide a vulnerability-reporting path only when configured and state only certifications or compliance claims that are actually verified.
Let visitors review boundaries, follow a configured disclosure channel, or continue to product and company context.
Close the page with navigation, trust, and contact context.
Provide the primary site navigation.
Identify Monarchic, LLC and state the Privacy policy’s scope, effective date, update date, and publication context.
Explain what the corporate website policy covers and distinguish it from separately governed product applications.
Describe verified submitted and automatically collected data, why it is processed, and how cookies, analytics, logs, forms, and consent operate.
Identify current processors, relevant transfer information, and actual retention periods or defensible retention criteria.
Explain applicable privacy rights, request procedures, and high-level data-protection practices without making absolute guarantees.
Require the published policy to match the implementation-time data inventory and complete legal review before release.
Provide configured privacy-request and policy-navigation paths without inventing unavailable destinations.
Close the page with navigation, trust, and contact context.
Provide the primary site navigation.
Identify Monarchic, LLC and state the Website Terms’ effective date, update date, and corporate-site scope.
Explain that these terms govern the informational corporate site and not separately governed products, accounts, subscriptions, pricing, or services.
State the legally reviewed permitted and prohibited uses of the corporate website and its functionality.
Cover branding, site content, research publications, downloadable artifacts, trademarks, and applicable external or open-source licenses.
Explain research and benchmark interpretation limits and clarify that external links and product applications are separately governed.
Contain only counsel-reviewed warranty, liability, change, continued-use, governing-law, dispute, and contact provisions.
Require the published terms to match the implemented website, published materials, outbound destinations, and licenses and to complete legal review.
Provide clear navigation to the related Privacy policy or back to the MCP product catalog.
Close the page with navigation, trust, and contact context.
